"""Record actual terminal states after every owned primary stage completes."""

import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V152-support-crossover-v1')
post = read(root / 'status-v1.json')
assert post['status'] == 'completed-audited-diagnostic-awaiting-native-viewing'
assert set(post['completed']) == {'review', 'scores', 'metric-audit', 'reconstruction-audit', 'render'}
assert all(v['owner_exited'] for v in post['completed'].values())
owners = [('controller', post['owner'])]
owners += [(stage, binding['owner']) for stage, binding in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners) == 6
records = []
for stage, owner in owners:
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        if abs(process.create_time() - owner['created']) >= .01:
            status = 'PID-reused-original-owner-terminal'
        else:
            status = process.status()
            assert status in ['zombie', 'dead'], (stage, owner, status)
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        status = 'absent'
    records.append({'stage': stage, 'owner': owner, 'terminal_state': status})
excluded = {os.getpid()} | {p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()}
matching = []
for process in psutil.process_iter(['pid', 'cmdline', 'status']):
    if process.pid in excluded or process.info['status'] in ['zombie', 'dead']:
        continue
    tokens = process.info['cmdline'] or []
    if any(t == str(root) or t.startswith(str(root) + '/')
           or t == str(root.relative_to(root.parents[2])) for t in tokens):
        matching.append(process.info)
assert not matching, matching
save(root / 'execution-completion-v1.json', {
    'status': 'all6-recorded-owners-terminal', 'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(),
    'recorded_owner_count': 6, 'owners': records, 'live_matching_root_argv': matching,
    'controller_completion': ref(root / 'status-v1.json'),
    'verifier': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope': 'Exact PID/create-time terminal checks for controller and five primary workers. All primary children returned zero in controller flow. No failed bootstrap or scientific retry. Root argv scan excludes verifier and ancestors. No stop, kill or restart.'})
print('PASS: all six recorded owners terminal; no live root argv matches')
